rows.evidence: Two M06 definitions with acceptance contracts: src/server/workspace/core-reactions.ts:71-79 (`m06-anchor-injection`, write-back, accepts markdown, no requirements) and :85-92 (`m06-section-indexer`, projection, requires ['m06-anchor-injection'], requiresFlags ['references']). The flag requirement is enforced at context build in src/server/fs/reactions.ts:74-78, called from src/server/workspace/project-context.ts:533. Phase order is write-back before projection and capture (m17-capture after ['write-back'], core-reactions.ts:123-129). The separate plan anchor reaction is gone: the only plan injection is the `m06-anchor-injection` binding on roots whose kind selects it (project-context.ts:1531-1542), and plans select injection without the indexer (src/shared/root-kinds.ts:137, references=false). Synchronous write-path trigger: src/server/services/plan.ts:40 (injectAnchorsFor). Tests: src/server/fs/reactions.test.ts:66-75 asserts toThrow(/m06-section-indexer.*requires flag 'references'/) and that injection alone does not throw; :58-64 covers the missing injection; src/server/services/plan-anchors.test.ts:30-37 asserts kindSelects('plans','m06-anchor-injection')===true and kindSelects('plans','m06-section-indexer')===false. Both tests would pass against the current code. Note, not counted: the plan path (src/server/services/anchor-injection.ts:28-30,55) anchors only levels 2-4, while the page path anchors every heading the parser returns (section-indexer.ts:243). This diverges slightly from 'tą samą definicją co strona'; it predates this window and is a drift candidate.

Only headings returned by the section parser are anchored, so nothing inside a code block is touched: src/server/services/section-indexer.ts:241-243 (parseSections, missing = anchor===null) and anchor-injection.ts:54-55. Occupancy scope follows the kind's choice. On kinds that select the indexer, the check is global in section_index (section-indexer.ts:211-221 freshAnchor, `SELECT 1 FROM section_index WHERE anchor = ?`), plus anchors already in the file and those minted in the same pass (:242,247). On injection-only kinds it is per file (anchor-injection.ts:37-46,59-61). The route is chosen by what the kind selects (project-context.ts:1533). Frontmatter-safe: frontmatter: false parse and the frontmatter is written back separately (section-indexer.ts:153-154). Injection runs once, on the first pass that finds a heading without an anchor, with suppress() before the write (:151-154). The indexer itself no longer injects (:384-386), and indexAll runs injection then the indexer, file by file (:330-344). Tests: src/server/discovery/section-indexing.test.ts:393-410 asserts the freshly minted anchor is not 'dupdupdu' (already occupied in section_index), and its rig drives injection then indexPage (:106-112). plan-anchors.test.ts:14-28 asserts one anchor per heading, an idempotent second pass and a code fence left untouched.

Entity auto-link (now step 8 of the 8-step pass, section-indexer.ts:65-68) reads tags with the shared parser, not with its own regexes: `const pageTags = parseXmlTags(body);` at src/server/services/section-indexer.ts:492. Tags are assigned to the owning section by line (:494), and the module filters only by tag name: tagged_list/tagged_list_mixed at :510-513, the other tags by the `type` attribute at :514-516. No stale step-9 or step-5 references remain in M06 code (grep on section-indexer*, discovery). Covered by the existing test src/server/services/section-indexer-tagged-list.test.ts (unchanged by this window's wording edit).
